scope: Matched-task qualification of the three inherited coding arms in their source-supported final form; no Gate A rewrite

task_selection.rule: Four lowest SHA256(seed_utf8 + full task name), independently within each of the six named repositories, from the pinned 500-task registry. No outcomes were used.
task_selection.source_preflight: All24 instruction.md, task.toml and tests/test.sh URLs returned HTTP200 at the dataset pin; all24 test.sh files declare swebench==4.0.3. coding-input-source-map.csv now binds24 native task-tree OIDs and original Dockerfile identities; coding-input-read.json retains registry manifests. Built-image identities and native digest enforcement remain required before freeze.

proposed_execution.order: Pinned task-list order; cycle native-codex/openhands-sdk/pi, openhands-sdk/pi/native-codex, pi/native-codex/openhands-sdk by task index; reverse that task's order for repeat2.
proposed_execution.isolation: Fresh per-task native state and identical immutable execution image per task across arms; evaluator tests and reference solutions remain outside the worker view.
proposed_execution.quota_rule: First quota/429 suspends all arms and records the incomplete block. Resume only the same frozen protocol in a newly coordinated window; preserve attempted usage and failures.
proposed_execution.native_effort_requirement: Bind each runtime's native effort and actual gateway inference envelope separately. Preserve Codex Ultra orchestration; do not equate Pi max-to-ultra serialization or OpenHands provider strings with that orchestration.
proposed_execution.compression: off control; token-feature conditions are a separate reviewed amendment on the same tasks, not stacked client compression
proposed_execution.window: Architecture-owned exclusive throwaway GPT-pool window, disjoint from session0c and token/GPU trials

proposed_decision_rule.quality: Use only unchanged upstream task reward after FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS. Provider/tool-task failures and timeouts score0; source/image/route/evaluator mismatches invalidate qualification rather than fabricate a reward. Retain all attempted conditions.

quality.measure: two-repeat success count per frozen task
quality.minimum: No task lower than the baseline
quality.improvement: At least one task greater than the baseline

quality_tie.agent_time: Paired median no greater than baseline

selection.otherwise: Retain the measured native baseline; report sampled failures and incomparability

proposed_decision_rule.limitations: This 24-task screen supports only the measured workload. It establishes no universal or statistically significant superiority; further confirmation follows any material fit/confidence gap.

required_before_freeze: Astra/max consequential read and one Claude-lane read of the concrete finalized protocol; exact accepted head and hash
Architecture allocation of the throwaway host/project/window and actual rootless container reachability to the existing keyless pool
Task-tree hashes, immutable base-image manifest digests and built-image IDs; the source Dockerfiles use mutable latest tags
Exact per-arm org-owned skills/extensions/plugins/MCP inventory, their source hashes, native loader configuration and useful activation checks
Supported native route configuration and negative control for alias/effort loss: Harbor Codex strips cx; its typed effort enum ends at max; inline config must be qualified
Pi1.0 provider-map qualification; the Harbor bridge's MCP version compatibility and max-to-ultra mapping must be resolved before claiming final-form parity
OpenHands Responses/capability/effort and skill-loading qualification for the actual model; matched1.50.1 packages verified inside each clean image
Native full/cache/reasoning usage and all child/auxiliary call collection, with observable enforcement of the proposed time/token envelope
Lifecycle and no-prompt/no-credential-copy qualification; no native auth.json upload or sign-in-store copying
Frozen task/config/source/extension hashes, resolved gateway build/carry and force rules, final grader/decision rule and freeze receipt before any comparative task
failures_preserved: The first GitHub contents read of the13.65MB registry returned empty content; JSON decoding failed. Direct pinned raw-source retrieval then established its bytes/hash.
